reviewer: Codex semantic review; not independent human review
basis: Frozen corpus and prewritten question/expected points; no live business database facts used to fill missing rules
correctness_definition: Question-level factual correctness and coverage of what the question asks, with no unsupported conflicting business conclusions. An answerable question that is refused is incorrect.
strict_completeness_definition: All prewritten expected points present; additional requirements in the frozen annotation are retained even if the question did not ask for them.
annotation_issue: Q32 expected_points additionally demand completed state and actual-delivery timestamp, but its question asks only the original state required by the two methods. Its answer is question-level correct but fails strict prewritten-point completeness. Original dataset is unchanged; both metrics are reported.
